title: Von Braun transmitted speech to Carol Rosin via mind interface

tellings.quote: It was for him to transmit to her a speech he wanted to give to a big conference.

plain: In the 1970s the rocket engineer Wernher von Braun is said to have used a kind of mind-to-mind link to pass a speech he wanted given at a big conference to his spokesperson, a woman named Carol Rosin. The UFO activist Steven Greer tells it, relaying what he was told. If true, it would mean von Braun had some form of mental communication.
